profile.headline: Engineering @ Vanta -- We're hiring!
profile.summary:
Founding Engineer at Clara Health (Series A) who built our core revenue driving platform features. Grew into a Software Engineering Manager and acting Head of Engineering, responsible for UI/UX design, product development, and regulatory compliance. 

Interested in in-person product engineering IC roles in San Francisco to further hone my engineering skills. For now I am primarily looking at Series B and later stage companies. I would intend to grow into an tech lead or engineering manager again in the future, once I am satisfied with my technical growth.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Acting Head of Engineering, owner of all engineering and UI/UX design for Clara Health product development efforts. Directly responsible for the technical portion of GXP Compliance System audits.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: Designed and implemented the World Without Covid registry project from ideation to full implementation, successfully connecting more than 10,000 people to COVID-19 trials for diagnosis, treatment, and vaccine discovery.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: First engineering hire at Clara Health. Developed the first revenue-driving product flow using React, Typescript, and Python. Owner of all front-end code bases, release processes, and support for the production environment.
